CourtSy. The Taster $45 A day inside the club

One full day with every facility open — courts, greens, the pool and the spa. The easiest way to show someone what the club actually feels like.

  • Every open facility for a day

  • Café credit included
  • Book any day, no notice needed
CourtSy. The Month $190 A month of Resident

Thirty days of full Resident membership. Long enough to build a habit, short enough to be an easy yes.

  • 24/7 access to every court & green
  • Two coached clinics a week
  • Recovery suite, sauna & spa
  • Priority booking, 14 days ahead
CourtSy. The Year $2,280 A whole year, everything in

Twelve months of Resident membership, start date of their choosing. The most generous thing on this page by some distance.

  • A full year of unlimited access
  • Clinics, recovery and events included

  • They choose when it begins
Good to know

The fine print, briefly.

When does it expire?

It doesn’t. Gift cards hold their value indefinitely and any unused balance simply stays on the card.

Can they upgrade it?

Yes — the card works like credit, so they can put it toward a longer or higher tier and pay the difference.

What if I want a different amount?

Choose any value at checkout. It behaves exactly like the three cards above, just with your number on it.

Can I choose when it arrives?

Pick any future date and we will deliver it that morning, with your message attached.
